subject: Silo Spark activation & credential orchestration
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@heliofin.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@heliofin.com>
Date: 2026-10-12 08:23 PDT
Subject: Expansion request — provisioning keys for 3 new projects

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're moving forward with adding three new internal projects onto our Redwood instance (Silo Spark program). High-level ask: new API keys for sandbox and prod for each project, staged rollout over two sprints, and a short runbook for our internal ops.

Quick answers you can use to scope: team sizes small (2–4 devs per project), expected peak RPS modest (50–200 rps aggregated), and we'd like per-key usage quotas. We also need the keys namespaced and tagged to our downstream billing tokens.

Can you confirm lead times and whether we need a signed addendum for the change in committed capacity? Attaching a proposed project matrix.

Thanks — Sam
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform Ops, Helio Financial

Attachment: silo-spark_project_matrix.csv (CSV, 1.2 KB)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@heliofin.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12 11:02 PDT
Subject: Re: Expansion request — provisioning keys for 3 new projects

Hi Sam — great to hear you want to expand. High level plan below, I included Priyom (AM) and Lauren (Onboarding PM) to own sequencing.

Plan summary:
- Scope & capacity: we reviewed your matrix and estimate no infra changes needed for initial burst. We recommend 2 prod pods (reserved) and sandbox on shared Hosted for the pilot.
- Timeline: key provisioning + tagging — 48 business hours after agreement on naming template. Staged rollout: Sprint A (pilot): 2 projects (sandbox + prod limited quotas); Sprint B (scale): remaining project + quota ramp.
- Paperwork: because this increases committed throughput, our billing team requires a short addendum. Priyom, can you confirm whether this qualifies as an amendment instead of a new MSA?

Attachments: credential-template.txt (template we use for API key naming and tags), runbook-Sprint-1.pdf (sample runbook).

Next steps for you: confirm preferred key name prefix and whether you want per-team rate limits or global caps.

Nikhil Sharma
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: credential-template.txt, runbook-Sprint-1.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <sam.lee@heliofin.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-13 09:15 PDT
Subject: Re: Expansion request — provisioning keys for 3 new projects

Hi all — quick note from a commercial perspective. This looks like an amendment to the existing deal (HL-2026-089). We can do a one-line addendum for committed pods and updated billing bands; no new MSA required. I will draft the addendum and share today.

Operational notes:
- We will create keys in the pattern HELIO-SILO-<PROJECT>-<ENV>-<SEQ>. Example: HELIO-SILO-LEDGER-PROD-01.
- For quotas: suggest sandbox = 10% of prod token limits for the pilot. We'll enable rate-limited burst windows for prod if you need short spikes.

Monica — can you confirm on-boarding bandwidth (Lauren will schedule) and whether we should open a staging incident channel during Sprint A?

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@heliofin.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-14 10:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Expansion request — provisioning keys for 3 new projects

Sam — I'm scheduling the kickoff for Sprint A on Tue 2026-10-20 at 10:00 PT (30m). Agenda: key naming and tagging, sandbox provisioning, quota baselines, and runbook handoff. I'll also attach the lightweight questionnaire we'll use to capture environment variables and CI/CD ownership.

Operational checklist (preview):
- Confirm key prefixes and tags
- Confirm initial quota per key and burst policy
- Sandbox creation on Hosted (shared) and prod reservation assignment
- Add Helio ops to monitoring dashboard and grant read-only console access for 2 engineers
- Finalize addendum and billing trigger date

Please reply with preferred attendees and any scheduling conflicts.

Best,
Monica Patel
Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: onboarding-questionnaire.pdf (form, 0.8 KB)

From: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@heliofin.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@heliofin.com>
Date: 2026-10-15 16:40 PDT
Subject: Re: Expansion request — provisioning keys for 3 new projects

Thanks — Tue 10/20 10:00 PT works for us. Attendees: myself, Carlos Mendez (DevOps), and Jenna Park (Backend lead) from Helio. Prefix approved: HELIO-SILO. We prefer per-team rate limits rather than a single global cap.

We signed the addendum draft Priyom sent this morning and returned it to legal; expect countersign by Fri. For the onboarding questionnaire — I've attached answers inline (see short answers below) and uploaded the filled matrix to the Drive link you shared.

Short answers:
- Preferred key naming: HELIO-SILO-<PROJECT>-<ENV>-<SEQ>
- Sandbox quotas: 250 rps total across sandboxes (shared)
- Prod initial quotas: 2000 rps per project (burst 4000 for 2 min windows)
- Monitoring access: grant read-only to sam.lee@heliofin.com and c.mendez@heliofin.com

Looking forward to the kickoff.

— Sam
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform Ops, Helio Financial

Attachment: filled-silo-matrix.csv (updated)
